pages.quiz:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is a way of conserving wild animals? (1 mark)
   A. Cutting down all trees
   B. Selling them
   C. Setting fires in the bush
   D. Protecting their homes such as forests

2. Which is an example of caring for fruit plants? (1 mark)
   A. Watering, weeding and mulching
   B. Burning the leaves
   C. Leaving them without water
   D. Cutting the roots

3. Which sign shows that a guava is ripe? (1 mark)
   A. It turns yellowish and smells sweet
   B. It has flowers on it
   C. It is dry and black
   D. It is dark green and hard

4. How do bees and butterflies help crops and fruit trees? (1 mark)
   A. They water the plants
   B. They dig the soil
   C. They carry pollen from flower to flower
   D. They eat the fruit

5. Which product does a dairy cow give? (1 mark)
   A. Wool
   B. Feathers
   C. Milk
   D. Eggs

6. Where should needles be kept? (1 mark)
   A. In a pin cushion or needle case
   B. On the floor
   C. In your mouth
   D. On a chair

7. Why is a tippy tap useful? (1 mark)
   A. It cleans clothes
   B. It makes soap
   C. It works without a water tap and saves water
   D. It needs electricity

8. What should you do if you smell gas in the kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. Light a match to see
   B. Switch on many lights
   C. Cover your nose and cook
   D. Close the cylinder valve and open windows and doors

9. Why are carrots not transplanted? (1 mark)
   A. They grow in water
   B. They are too large
   C. They have no roots
   D. Moving damages the root and makes it crooked

10. Why should chemicals not be used to clean PPE unless an adult directs you? (1 mark)
   A. They can harm the skin and the material
   B. They are too cheap
   C. They cool the PPE
   D. They make it too clean

11. What should you use to brush your teeth? (1 mark)
   A. A toothbrush and toothpaste
   B. A comb
   C. A cloth soaked in oil
   D. A knife

12. What should you do if you prick your finger? (1 mark)
   A. Tell the teacher and wash with soap and water
   B. Ignore it
   C. Hide it
   D. Put dirt on it

13. What is boiling? (1 mark)
   A. Cooking food in bubbling hot water
   B. Cooking in the sun
   C. Cooking without heat
   D. Cooking in a little oil

14. Which of these is an energy-giving food? (1 mark)
   A. Spinach
   B. Fish
   C. Orange
   D. Ugali

15. In which direction do you sweep a room? (1 mark)
   A. Only the middle
   B. Randomly
   C. From the corners towards the middle or door
   D. Only along the walls

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain how mulch and compost help a young fruit tree. (4 marks)

17. Explain how to look after a compost heap for two months. (4 marks)

18. Why must a passion fruit plant have a trellis? (2 marks)

19. Give two ways of protecting fruits from birds and monkeys without killing them. (2 marks)

20. Give three uses of goats. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Protecting their homes such as forests
   Protecting habitats lets animals live.

2. A — Watering, weeding and mulching
   Care keeps plants healthy.

3. A — It turns yellowish and smells sweet
   Ripe guavas change colour and smell sweet.

4. C — They carry pollen from flower to flower
   Pollination helps fruits and seeds to form.

5. C — Milk
   Dairy cows are kept for milk.

6. A — In a pin cushion or needle case
   Needles are sharp.

7. C — It works without a water tap and saves water
   It can be made from a jerrican.

8. D — Close the cylinder valve and open windows and doors
   Fire near a gas leak can cause an explosion.

9. D — Moving damages the root and makes it crooked
   The carrot root is the food, so it must grow straight.

10. A — They can harm the skin and the material
   Chemicals can be dangerous.

11. A — A toothbrush and toothpaste
   These clean teeth safely.

12. A — Tell the teacher and wash with soap and water
   Clean the wound.

13. A — Cooking food in bubbling hot water
   Boiling uses hot water.

14. D — Ugali
   Ugali is a starchy staple.

15. C — From the corners towards the middle or door
   This gathers dirt in one place.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Mulch keeps the soil moist, reduces weeds and protects roots from heat. Compost feeds the tree and improves soil structure.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for mulch, 2 marks for compost.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Keep it damp like a squeezed sponge, keep it covered, turn it after two to three weeks, and keep children and animals away.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct care activity, up to 4.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Its stem is soft and cannot stand, so the trellis supports it as it climbs and spreads.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for soft stem, 1 mark for support.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Cover with nets, use scarecrows, noise or shiny objects (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Meat, milk, skins, manure and income (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each use.
